formalPoints: SAP secures platform layers; you secure apps, identities, data, configs.
commonMistakes: Memorizing the name of Shared Responsibility without a failure example
howToApply: Use Shared Responsibility explicitly in an architecture defense sentence
title: Shared Responsibility
summary: SAP secures platform layers; you secure apps, identities, data, configs.
explain: SAP secures platform layers; you secure apps, identities, data, configs. In Odyssey simulations this is modeled at Tier 1–2 fidelity with explicit labels — verify production details in official SAP documentation.
analogy: Practical memory hook: associate "Shared Responsibility" with a concrete failure mode you have seen or will simulate in a mission.
whyItMatters: If you cannot explain Shared Responsibility in one minute, you will mis-diagnose related incidents.
mnemonic: NAME IT TO TAME IT: Say “Shared Responsibility” + one failure mode out loud — if you can't, you don't own it yet. (Shared → mechanism → failure)
useCases: Greenfield design workshop: decide if “Shared Responsibility” is required given constraints (latency, clean-core, team skills).
Incident bridge: symptoms appear; use “Shared Responsibility” to classify the failing hop before changing config.
Architecture review board: defend why you accepted residual risk around “Shared Responsibility”.
